title: Cross-Model Agreement as a Red Flag: Building a Disagreement-Prioritized Review Queue

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: using inter-model disagreement as a signal for human review directly addresses AI oversight scalability. The tool is immediately deployable if validated.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible with guidance: building a multi-model query system and computing disagreement scores is API-based work. Evaluating whether flagged queries have more errors is straightforward analysis.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable: implement the disagreement scoring system, run on a test set, evaluate precision/recall of disagreement as a safety signal. Clear software deliverable.

novelty.reasoning: The use of inter-model disagreement as a signal for human review is actively being explored. Stage-aware governance already operationalizes disagreement as an uncertainty signal in literature review. Multi-agent debate frameworks also use disagreement for hallucination detection. However, no existing work specifically frames this as a 'disagreement-prioritized review queue' for general safety applications, nor evaluates precision/recall of disagreement as a safety signal across domains. The concept is partially addressed but the specific safety-focused evaluation tool is novel.

evidence.source: Stage-Aware Governance of LLMs for AI-Assisted Literature Review (MDPI Systems, 2025)
evidence.finding: Operationalizes inter-model disagreement as an actionable uncertainty signal that triggers human oversight. LLMs automate screening while disagreement flags cases for human review.

evidence.source: Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) frameworks for hallucination detection
evidence.finding: Multi-agent debate frameworks use disagreement between agents to expose faulty reasoning and suppress hallucinations via iterative verification.

evidence.source: How Would a 5-Model AI Boardroom Reduce Hallucinations
evidence.finding: Proposes cross-model disagreement protocols to make it mathematically harder for hallucinations to propagate.
